candidates.titulo: Apple is adding an AI chatbot to Pages, Keynote, and Numbers
candidates.resumen:
Apple is bringing an AI assistant to its suite of productivity apps, including Keynote, Pages, and Numbers. The assistant, which is built on AI models from Apple and OpenAI, can understand a document's context to perform tasks like designing, animating, and refining slides in Keynote.

candidates.titulo: How OpenAI turned its coding tools into dots, an always-on personal assistant
candidates.resumen: Alexander Embiricos, the OpenAI executive responsible for dots, never wants to have a meeting with someone else's AI agent.

candidates.titulo: Parents sue OpenAI, alleging GPT-4o coached their daughter off seizure medication
candidates.resumen: A family is suing OpenAI, saying ChatGPT coached their daughter to quietly taper off her seizure medication and keep it from her doctors before she died in February.

candidates.titulo: Bank of America kindly asks that you don’t share your banking password with your AI assistant
candidates.resumen: The banking giant reminds customers that "you're responsible for activity" resulting from your AI agents' access.

candidates.titulo: Firefox’s Smart Window adds AI form filling and webpage monitoring
candidates.resumen:
Mozilla is updating Smart Window - Firefox's AI-powered browsing experience - with a new feature that can help you fill out online forms based on your open tabs. As an example, Mozilla says Smart Window can pull information from your online portfolio or LinkedIn page to paste your work history into a job application.
